text: Why do wipers always stop at the bottom?
Switch them off mid-swipe, and they keep going.
Inside, the motor turns a gear with a copper ring. The ring has one gap.
The switch is off, but power still flows through the ring to the motor.
So the motor keeps turning, until the gap reaches the contact.
No contact, no power. The wipers stop right at the bottom.
One gap in a copper ring parks your wipers.
